pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with smooth, curvilinear edge gradients. Spatial area is variable, showing larger, elongated shapes on the mid-flank and smaller, more rounded patches toward the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of light-toned pathways with frequent tri-radial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively consistent, maintaining continuity across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dense mane is visible along the dorsal neck ridge, creating a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette with small vertical pixel protrusions against the background.
